## Setup

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(lubridate)
library(readr)
library(tidyr)

ASOS <- read.table("data/ASOS_ST.txt", sep = ",", header = TRUE)
```

## Cloud Cover Functions

```{r}
cloud_cover_to_fraction <- function(sky_condition) {
  case_when(
    sky_condition == "SKC" | sky_condition == "CLR" ~ 0.0,
    sky_condition == "FEW" ~ 0.125,
    sky_condition == "SCT" ~ 0.375,
    sky_condition == "BKN" ~ 0.625,
    sky_condition == "OVC" ~ 1.0,
    TRUE ~ NA_real_
  )
}

categorize_cloud_cover <- function(sky_condition) {
  case_when(
    sky_condition == "SKC" | sky_condition == "CLR" ~ "Clear",
    sky_condition == "FEW" ~ "Few",
    sky_condition == "SCT" ~ "Scattered",
    sky_condition == "BKN" ~ "Broken",
    sky_condition == "OVC" ~ "Overcast",
    TRUE ~ "Missing"
  )
}

assign_wy_month <- function(datetime) {
  calendar_month <- month(datetime)
  wy_month_num   <- ifelse(calendar_month >= 10, calendar_month - 9, calendar_month + 3)
  factor(wy_month_num, levels = 1:12,
         labels = c("Oct","Nov","Dec","Jan","Feb","Mar",
                    "Apr","May","Jun","Jul","Aug","Sep"))
}
```

## 1. Cloud Cover Frequency — Lowest Deck vs All Decks (WY2024)

```{r}
data_wy24 <- ASOS %>%
  mutate(datetime = ymd_hm(valid)) %>%
  filter(datetime >= ymd("2023-10-01") & datetime <= ymd("2024-09-30")) %>%
  filter(format(datetime, "%Y-%m") %in%
           c("2023-10","2023-11","2023-12","2024-01","2024-02","2024-03",
             "2024-04","2024-05","2024-06","2024-07","2024-08","2024-09"))

processed_data <- data_wy24 %>%
  mutate(
    datetime      = ymd_hm(valid),
    wy_month      = assign_wy_month(datetime),
    cloud_type_lowest   = categorize_cloud_cover(skyc1),
    cloud_fraction_lowest = cloud_cover_to_fraction(skyc1),
    skyc1_frac = cloud_cover_to_fraction(skyc1),
    skyc2_frac = cloud_cover_to_fraction(skyc2),
    skyc3_frac = cloud_cover_to_fraction(skyc3),
    skyc4_frac = cloud_cover_to_fraction(skyc4),
    all_decks_fraction = pmax(
      ifelse(is.na(skyc1_frac), 0, skyc1_frac),
      ifelse(is.na(skyc2_frac), 0, skyc2_frac),
      ifelse(is.na(skyc3_frac), 0, skyc3_frac),
      ifelse(is.na(skyc4_frac), 0, skyc4_frac),
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    cloud_type_all = case_when(
      all_decks_fraction == 0.0  ~ "Clear",
      all_decks_fraction <= 0.125 ~ "Few",
      all_decks_fraction <= 0.375 ~ "Scattered",
      all_decks_fraction < 1.0   ~ "Broken",
      all_decks_fraction == 1.0  ~ "Overcast",
      TRUE ~ "Missing"
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(cloud_fraction_lowest))

hourly_data <- processed_data %>%
  group_by(wy_month, date = date(datetime), hour = hour(datetime)) %>%
  summarise(
    cloud_type_lowest     = first(cloud_type_lowest),
    cloud_fraction_lowest = mean(cloud_fraction_lowest, na.rm = TRUE),
    cloud_type_all        = first(cloud_type_all),
    cloud_fraction_all    = mean(all_decks_fraction, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

monthly_freq_lowest <- hourly_data %>%
  count(wy_month, cloud_type_lowest) %>%
  group_by(wy_month) %>%
  mutate(total_obs = sum(n), frequency = n / total_obs * 100,
         analysis_type = "Lowest Deck Only") %>%
  filter(cloud_type_lowest != "Missing") %>%
  rename(cloud_type = cloud_type_lowest) %>%
  ungroup()

monthly_freq_all <- hourly_data %>%
  count(wy_month, cloud_type_all) %>%
  group_by(wy_month) %>%
  mutate(total_obs = sum(n), frequency = n / total_obs * 100,
         analysis_type = "All Cloud Decks") %>%
  filter(cloud_type_all != "Missing") %>%
  rename(cloud_type = cloud_type_all) %>%
  ungroup()

monthly_freq_combined <- bind_rows(monthly_freq_lowest, monthly_freq_all)

monthly_avg_lowest <- hourly_data %>%
  group_by(wy_month) %>%
  summarise(avg_cloud_fraction = mean(cloud_fraction_lowest, na.rm = TRUE),
            analysis_type = "Lowest Deck Only", .groups = "drop")

monthly_avg_all <- hourly_data %>%
  group_by(wy_month) %>%
  summarise(avg_cloud_fraction = mean(cloud_fraction_all, na.rm = TRUE),
            analysis_type = "All Cloud Decks", .groups = "drop")

monthly_avg_combined <- bind_rows(monthly_avg_lowest, monthly_avg_all)

p1 <- ggplot() +
  geom_col(data = monthly_freq_combined %>%
             mutate(cloud_type = factor(cloud_type,
                                       levels = c("Overcast","Broken","Scattered","Few","Clear"))),
           aes(x = wy_month, y = frequency, fill = cloud_type),
           position = "stack", alpha = 0.8, width = 0.7) +
  geom_line(data = monthly_avg_combined,
            aes(x = as.numeric(wy_month), y = avg_cloud_fraction * 100, group = 1),
            color = "red", linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_point(data = monthly_avg_combined,
             aes(x = as.numeric(wy_month), y = avg_cloud_fraction * 100),
             color = "black", size = 2) +
  facet_wrap(~ analysis_type, ncol = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(name = "Cloud Cover Type",
    values = c("Clear"="#87CEEB","Few"="#98FB98","Scattered"="#FFD700",
               "Broken"="#FFA500","Overcast"="#696969"),
    breaks = c("Clear","Few","Scattered","Broken","Overcast")) +
  scale_y_continuous(name = "Cloud Cover Type Frequency (%)", limits = c(0, 100),
    sec.axis = sec_axis(~ . / 100, name = "Average Cloud Cover Fraction",
                        breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.2))) +
  labs(title = "Cloud Cover Frequency: Lowest Deck vs All Decks",
       subtitle = "TEX ASOS Station - Water Year 2024",
       x = "Water Year Month",
       caption = "Red line: Average monthly cloud cover fraction") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "bottom")

print(p1)
```

## 2. Precipitation Probability (Hourly Basis, WY2024)

```{r}
processed_data_precip <- ASOS %>%
  mutate(
    datetime      = ymd_hm(valid),
    cloud_type    = categorize_cloud_cover(skyc1),
    cloud_fraction = cloud_cover_to_fraction(skyc1),
    p01m = p01i * 25.4,
    has_precip = p01m > 0
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(cloud_fraction))

hourly_data_all <- processed_data_precip %>%
  group_by(year = year(datetime), month = month(datetime, label = TRUE),
           date = date(datetime), hour = hour(datetime)) %>%
  summarise(
    cloud_type    = first(cloud_type),
    cloud_fraction = mean(cloud_fraction, na.rm = TRUE),
    p01m          = max(p01m, na.rm = TRUE),
    has_precip    = any(has_precip, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

hourly_data_wy24 <- hourly_data_all %>%
  mutate(datetime = ymd_hm(paste(date, hour, ":00"))) %>%
  filter(datetime >= ymd("2023-10-01") & datetime <= ymd("2024-09-30")) %>%
  mutate(wy_month = assign_wy_month(datetime))

precip_analysis <- hourly_data_wy24 %>%
  mutate(
    has_measurable_precip = p01m >= 0.254,
    has_any_precip        = p01m > 0,
    has_trace_only        = p01m > 0 & p01m < 0.254
  ) %>%
  group_by(wy_month) %>%
  summarise(
    total_hours         = n(),
    hours_with_measurable = sum(has_measurable_precip, na.rm = TRUE),
    hours_with_any      = sum(has_any_precip, na.rm = TRUE),
    freq_without_trace  = hours_with_measurable / total_hours * 100,
    freq_with_trace     = hours_with_any / total_hours * 100,
    trace_only_freq     = sum(has_trace_only, na.rm = TRUE) / total_hours * 100,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

p2 <- ggplot(precip_analysis, aes(x = wy_month)) +
  geom_col(aes(y = freq_without_trace), fill = "#d73027", alpha = 0.8, width = 0.6) +
  geom_line(aes(y = trace_only_freq, group = 1), color = "orange", linewidth = 1.5) +
  geom_point(aes(y = trace_only_freq), color = "orange", size = 3) +
  labs(title = "Monthly Precipitation Frequency (WY2024)",
       x = "Water Year Month", y = "Precipitation Frequency (% of hours)",
       caption = "Red bars: Measurable (≥0.254 mm) | Orange line: Trace events only") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

print(p2)
```

## 3. Precipitation Form in Clouds (WY2024)

```{r}
TELLURIDE_ELEVATION_M <- 8750 * 0.3048
STANDARD_LAPSE_RATE   <- 0.65

cloud_precip_all <- data_wy24 %>%
  mutate(
    tmpf  = as.numeric(ifelse(tmpf  == "M" | tmpf  == "" | is.na(tmpf),  NA, tmpf)),
    skyl1 = as.numeric(ifelse(skyl1 == "M" | skyl1 == "" | is.na(skyl1), NA, skyl1)),
    datetime = ymd_hm(valid),
    wy_month = assign_wy_month(datetime)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(skyc1), skyc1 != "CLR", skyc1 != "SKC") %>%
  mutate(
    temp_c             = ifelse(!is.na(tmpf), (tmpf - 32) * 5/9, NA),
    cloud_base_m_agl   = ifelse(!is.na(skyl1), skyl1 * 0.3048, NA),
    height_diff_100m   = ifelse(!is.na(cloud_base_m_agl), cloud_base_m_agl / 100, NA),
    temp_at_cloud_base = ifelse(!is.na(temp_c) & !is.na(height_diff_100m),
                               temp_c - (STANDARD_LAPSE_RATE * height_diff_100m), NA),
    precip_form = case_when(
      is.na(temp_c) | is.na(cloud_base_m_agl) ~ "Unknown",
      temp_at_cloud_base > 0   ~ "Liquid (Rain)",
      temp_at_cloud_base <= 0  ~ "Solid (Snow/Ice)",
      TRUE ~ "Unknown"
    )
  )

monthly_precip_form <- cloud_precip_all %>%
  group_by(wy_month) %>%
  summarise(
    total_obs   = n(),
    liquid_pct  = sum(precip_form == "Liquid (Rain)") / total_obs * 100,
    solid_pct   = sum(precip_form == "Solid (Snow/Ice)") / total_obs * 100,
    unknown_pct = sum(precip_form == "Unknown") / total_obs * 100,
    avg_surface_temp    = mean(temp_c, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_cloud_base_m    = mean(cloud_base_m_agl, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_cloud_temp      = mean(temp_at_cloud_base, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

monthly_precip_long <- monthly_precip_form %>%
  select(wy_month, solid_pct, liquid_pct, unknown_pct, avg_cloud_temp) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(solid_pct, liquid_pct, unknown_pct),
               names_to = "precip_type", values_to = "percentage") %>%
  mutate(precip_type = factor(precip_type,
                              levels = c("unknown_pct","liquid_pct","solid_pct"),
                              labels = c("Unknown","Liquid (Rain)","Solid (Snow/Ice)")))

p_form <- ggplot() +
  geom_col(data = monthly_precip_long,
           aes(x = wy_month, y = percentage, fill = precip_type),
           position = "stack", alpha = 0.8, width = 0.8) +
  geom_line(data = monthly_precip_form,
            aes(x = wy_month, y = (avg_cloud_temp + 20) * 2.5, group = 1),
            color = "orange", linewidth = 1.5) +
  geom_point(data = monthly_precip_form,
             aes(x = wy_month, y = (avg_cloud_temp + 20) * 2.5),
             color = "orange", size = 3) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = (0 + 20) * 2.5, color = "black",
             linetype = "dashed", alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_fill_manual(name = "Precipitation Form",
    values = c("Solid (Snow/Ice)" = "#2166ac", "Liquid (Rain)" = "#762a83",
               "Unknown" = "#969696")) +
  scale_y_continuous(name = "% of Cloudy Observations", limits = c(0, 100),
    sec.axis = sec_axis(~ (. / 2.5) - 20, name = "Avg Cloud Base Temp (°C)",
                        breaks = seq(-15, 15, 5))) +
  labs(title = "Monthly Distribution of Precipitation Form in Clouds (WY2024)",
       subtitle = "TEX ASOS — Water Year 2024",
       x = "Water Year Month",
       caption = "Orange line: Avg cloud base temp | Black dashed: 0°C") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "bottom")

print(p_form)

print(monthly_precip_form %>%
      select(wy_month, total_obs, solid_pct, liquid_pct, unknown_pct,
             avg_surface_temp, avg_cloud_base_m, avg_cloud_temp) %>%
      mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(., 1))))
```

## 4. Snow Crystal Morphology (WY2024)

```{r}
classify_snow_crystal <- function(temp_c, supersaturation) {
  case_when(
    temp_c > 0 ~ "No Snow (Liquid)",
    temp_c >= -5 ~ case_when(
      supersaturation >= 0.15 ~ "Needles",
      supersaturation >= 0.05 ~ "Solid Plates",
      TRUE ~ "Thin Plates"),
    temp_c >= -10 ~ case_when(
      supersaturation >= 0.2  ~ "Needles",
      supersaturation >= 0.1  ~ "Hollow Columns",
      TRUE ~ "Solid Plates"),
    temp_c >= -15 ~ case_when(
      supersaturation >= 0.25 ~ "Stellars",
      supersaturation >= 0.15 ~ "Sectored Plates",
      supersaturation >= 0.1  ~ "Solid Plates",
      TRUE ~ "Thin Plates"),
    temp_c >= -22 ~ case_when(
      supersaturation >= 0.2 ~ "Stellars",
      supersaturation >= 0.1 ~ "Plates",
      TRUE ~ "Columns"),
    TRUE ~ "Columns"
  )
}

estimate_supersaturation <- function(temp_c, rh_percent) {
  case_when(
    is.na(rh_percent)   ~ NA_real_,
    rh_percent >= 95    ~ 0.25,
    rh_percent >= 85    ~ 0.15,
    rh_percent >= 70    ~ 0.08,
    TRUE                ~ 0.03
  )
}

snow_crystal_data <- data_wy24 %>%
  mutate(
    tmpf  = as.numeric(ifelse(tmpf  == "M" | is.na(tmpf),  NA, tmpf)),
    skyl1 = as.numeric(ifelse(skyl1 == "M" | is.na(skyl1), NA, skyl1)),
    relh  = as.numeric(ifelse(relh  == "M" | is.na(relh),  NA, relh)),
    datetime = ymd_hm(valid),
    wy_month = assign_wy_month(datetime)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(skyc1), skyc1 != "CLR", skyc1 != "SKC") %>%
  mutate(
    temp_c             = ifelse(!is.na(tmpf), (tmpf - 32) * 5/9, NA),
    cloud_base_m_agl   = ifelse(!is.na(skyl1), skyl1 * 0.3048, NA),
    height_diff_100m   = ifelse(!is.na(cloud_base_m_agl), cloud_base_m_agl / 100, NA),
    temp_at_cloud_base = ifelse(!is.na(temp_c) & !is.na(height_diff_100m),
                               temp_c - (STANDARD_LAPSE_RATE * height_diff_100m), NA),
    supersaturation  = estimate_supersaturation(temp_at_cloud_base, relh),
    crystal_type     = case_when(
      is.na(temp_at_cloud_base) | is.na(supersaturation) ~ "Unknown",
      TRUE ~ classify_snow_crystal(temp_at_cloud_base, supersaturation)
    ),
    crystal_category = case_when(
      crystal_type %in% c("Columns","Hollow Columns","Solid Prisms") ~ "Columns",
      crystal_type %in% c("Thin Plates","Solid Plates","Sectored Plates","Plates") ~ "Plates",
      crystal_type == "Needles"          ~ "Needles",
      crystal_type == "Stellars"         ~ "Stellars",
      crystal_type == "No Snow (Liquid)" ~ "No Snow",
      TRUE ~ "Unknown"
    )
  )

monthly_crystal_form <- snow_crystal_data %>%
  group_by(wy_month) %>%
  summarise(
    total_obs    = n(),
    columns_pct  = sum(crystal_category == "Columns")  / total_obs * 100,
    plates_pct   = sum(crystal_category == "Plates")   / total_obs * 100,
    needles_pct  = sum(crystal_category == "Needles")  / total_obs * 100,
    stellars_pct = sum(crystal_category == "Stellars") / total_obs * 100,
    unknown_pct  = sum(crystal_category == "Unknown")  / total_obs * 100,
    avg_cloud_temp       = mean(temp_at_cloud_base, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_supersaturation  = mean(supersaturation, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

monthly_snow_long <- monthly_crystal_form %>%
  select(wy_month, columns_pct, plates_pct, needles_pct, stellars_pct, unknown_pct) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(columns_pct, plates_pct, needles_pct, stellars_pct, unknown_pct),
               names_to = "crystal_type", values_to = "percentage") %>%
  mutate(crystal_type = factor(crystal_type,
    levels = c("unknown_pct","stellars_pct","needles_pct","plates_pct","columns_pct"),
    labels = c("Unknown","Stellars","Needles","Plates","Columns")))

p_crystal <- ggplot() +
  geom_col(data = monthly_snow_long,
           aes(x = wy_month, y = percentage, fill = crystal_type),
           position = "stack", alpha = 0.9, width = 0.8) +
  geom_line(data = monthly_crystal_form,
            aes(x = wy_month, y = (avg_cloud_temp + 25) * 2, group = 1),
            color = "black", linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_point(data = monthly_crystal_form,
             aes(x = wy_month, y = (avg_cloud_temp + 25) * 2),
             color = "black", size = 3) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = (0 + 25) * 2, color = "red",
             linetype = "dashed", alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_fill_manual(name = "Snow Crystal Type",
    values = c("Columns"="#1f77b4","Plates"="#ff7f0e","Needles"="#2ca02c",
               "Stellars"="#d62728","Unknown"="#7f7f7f")) +
  scale_y_continuous(name = "% of Cloudy Observations", limits = c(0, 100),
    sec.axis = sec_axis(~ (. / 2) - 25, name = "Avg Cloud Base Temp (°C)",
                        breaks = seq(-40, 10, 5))) +
  labs(title = "Monthly Distribution of Snow Crystal Types in Clouds",
       subtitle = "TEX ASOS — Water Year 2024",
       x = "Water Year Month",
       caption = "Black line: Avg cloud base temp | Red dashed: 0°C") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "bottom")

print(p_crystal)

print(monthly_crystal_form %>%
      select(wy_month, total_obs, columns_pct, plates_pct, needles_pct,
             stellars_pct, unknown_pct) %>%
      mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(., 1))))
```
